memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: She runs her florist shop in Hebbal, stands for about four to five hours each day, and reports only mild fatigue by evening.
cognition: Mini‑Cog score is 3 out of 5, indicating no cognitive impairment at this time.
falls: She reports no falls in the last twelve months, her gait is steady, and timed up‑and‑go test is 10 seconds (within normal limits).
medicines: She is currently on metformin 500 mg BD, combined oral contraceptive pill OD, cholecalciferol 60 000 IU weekly (loading phase), melatonin 3 mg HS, and trazodone 50 mg HS – five regular medicines, which meets the threshold for polypharmacy; a review against the Beers criteria is advised.
mood: She describes occasional low mood but denies any depressive symptoms or suicidal thoughts.
carers: Ramesh, husband.
goals: "I want to keep running my flower shop and feel energetic."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum testosterone: 48 ng/dL (ref 15‑70). LH:FSH ratio: 2.2 (ref <2.5). HbA1c: 5.8% (ref 4‑5.6). Serum 25‑hydroxyvitamin D: 18 ng/mL (ref 30‑100). Serum calcium: 9.2 mg/dL (ref 8.5‑10.5). Serum phosphate: 3.4 mg/dL (ref 2.5‑4.5). Hemoglobin: 13.2 g/dL (ref 12‑16). TSH: 2.1 µIU/mL (ref 0.4‑4.0).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
Metformin 500 mg tablet – take one tablet twice daily after meals.
Combined oral contraceptive pill (ethinylestradiol 0.03 mg + levonorgestrel 0.15 mg) – take one tablet daily.
Cholecalciferol 60 000 IU capsule – take one capsule once weekly for 8 weeks, then 1000 IU once daily.
Melatonin 3 mg tablet – take one tablet at bedtime.
Trazodone 50 mg tablet – take one tablet at bedtime.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: She continues to manage the flower shop, reports occasional foot soreness after long standing, otherwise able to work full days.
cognition: Mini‑Cog score 3/5 (stable).
falls: No falls in past year; gait slightly cautious due to foot discomfort; timed up‑and‑go 11 seconds (borderline).
medicines: Metformin 500 mg BD, COCP OD, cholecalciferol 1000 IU OD (after loading), melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS – five regular medicines, polypharmacy flagged; recommend Beers review.
mood: Reports improved sleep, mood stable, denies anxiety.
carers: Ramesh, husband.
goals: "I want to stay on my feet all day without foot pain."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
Cholecalciferol 2000 IU tablet – take one tablet daily (increase from 1000 IU).
All other medications unchanged.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for 2025-10-05 at 10:30 AM with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06) for follow‑up review.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: She notes mild aching in heels after morning shop opening; uses supportive insoles, reports better endurance.
cognition: Mini‑Cog 3/5 (unchanged).
falls: No falls in last year; gait steady with insoles; timed up‑and‑go 10 seconds (normal).
medicines: Metformin 500 mg BD, COCP OD, cholecalciferol 2000 IU OD, melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS – five regular medicines, polypharmacy; advise Beers review.
mood: Sleep quality good, mood stable.
carers: Ramesh, husband.
goals: "I want to walk comfortably to the market and back."

memories.text:

Hemoglobin: 13.0 g/dL (ref 12‑16).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
Trazodone 50 mg tablet – take one tablet at bedtime (continue).
Melatonin 3 mg tablet – take one tablet at bedtime (continue).
No changes to metformin, COCP, or vitamin D.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: She works full days at the flower shop, occasional knee stiffness after prolonged standing, manages with occasional paracetamol.
cognition: Mini‑Cog score 2/5 – positive screen (≤2), plan for formal cognitive assessment.
falls: One fall reported in past year (tripped over rug at home, no injury); gait slightly unsteady; timed up‑and‑go 13 seconds (raised fall risk) – advise strength‑balance exercises and proper footwear.
medicines: Metformin 500 mg BD, COCP OD, cholecalciferol 2000 IU OD, melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS – five regular medicines, polypharmacy; recommend Beers review.
mood: Reports occasional low mood, denies hopelessness.
carers: Ramesh, husband.
goals: "I want to stay independent and keep my shop open for as long as possible."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: She continues floral work, reports mild fatigue after long hours, uses a stool for occasional rest.
cognition: Formal cognitive assessment completed; mild memory lapses noted, overall stable.
falls: No new falls in past year; gait steady with walking aid; timed up‑and‑go 11 seconds (borderline).
medicines: Metformin 500 mg BD, COCP OD, cholecalciferol 2000 IU OD, melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS – five regular medicines, polypharmacy; Beers review advised.
mood: Mood stable, reports good sleep.
carers: Ramesh, husband.
goals: "I want to enjoy my work and time with family without worrying about health."
